headline: Furman and Wofford finish level at the top
dek: Furman and Wofford close the conference season level at the head of the table, with ETSU and UNC Greensboro, neither beaten by a SOCON side, just behind them. Furman's 36 goals in all matches are more than any other programme in the conference has scored.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Away from Mercer, the conference scores at much the same rate; Mercer's seven goals in all matches are the one break in the shape.

wire.line: Mercer close the season without a win and with seven goals scored all year.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches stand past their date with no result, all of them from August and none of them between SOCON sides.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: VMI concede 47 goals in all matches, more than any other SOCON programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UNC Greensboro's 31 goals come from at least twelve different scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Henry Hampshaw makes 78 saves for Mercer and concedes 27, a save percentage of .743.

last_match.line: Liberty came in off away wins at Furman and at UNC Greensboro.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
